style: Single-panel humorous cartoon illustration, expressive hand-drawn style with bold ink outlines, flat warm colours and light paper texture, exaggerated comic facial expressions and body language, clean simple background, square composition. No text, no letters, no captions, no speech bubbles.

stories.2: A young woman on a park bench interrogating her boyfriend with a checklist and a raised eyebrow. He sits smugly with a halo over his head, but his nose has grown long like Pinocchio's and his fingers are crossed behind his back. Her expression turns from impressed to suspicious.
stories.3: Three contractors in front of a white picket fence of a grand white mansion. Two of them busily measure with tape measures and calculators; the third, a slick city guy in sunglasses and a pinstripe suit, lounges against the fence smoking a cigar, grinning and leaning in to whisper a sneaky deal to the shocked official holding a clipboard.
stories.7: A park bench scene: a middle-aged man in a rumpled office suit with a blank, dopey face sits next to an indignant middle-aged office woman who glares at him. The man looks glumly resigned, holding a briefcase full of paperwork, both wearing identical office ID badges.
stories.8: A university lecture hall. A stern professor points approvingly at a proud student named Peter standing up, while the student beside him jumps up eagerly with a huge grin, pointing at himself and pretending to be someone else, a name tag on his shirt hastily crossed out.
stories.9: A lineman perched high on an electric pole calls down to his coworker on the ground, who is cautiously holding two dangling cables. Two other cables dangle nearby crackling with bright cartoon sparks and lightning bolts. The man on the ground realises with wide horrified eyes how close he came; the man on top looks cheerfully relieved.
stories.13: Late at night, a very drunk man with loosened tie and wobbly legs leans against the wrong front door, confessing guiltily. In the doorway stands a sweet elderly neighbour lady in a nightgown and curlers, smiling kindly and patting his shoulder, pointing him toward the next house down the street where an angry wife silhouette waits in a lit window.
stories.19: Three excavation pits side by side. In the first, an American archaeologist proudly holds up an old copper wire; in the second, a Japanese archaeologist triumphantly holds up a fibre-optic cable; in the third, much deeper pit, a Vietnamese archaeologist holds up absolutely nothing but beams with pride, gesturing grandly at the empty dirt as if it proves ancient wireless phones.
stories.29: Two cartoon venomous snakes slithering through the grass. One snake looks smugly confident; the other has its forked tongue sticking out, swollen and bandaged, eyes watering in panic and worry as it realises it just bit its own tongue.
stories.46: A golf course under a stormy sky. A priest lies flat on the green, singed and smoking from a lightning bolt, while a cowboy golfer stands next to him, frozen mid-swear with his mouth open and hat blown off. From the dark clouds above, a giant cartoon hand holding a lightning bolt facepalms in frustration at the missed aim.
stories.47: Outside a robbed bank, a sly bank manager in a suit whispers to a reporter with a notepad, holding up fingers to exaggerate the amount. In the background, a robber in a striped shirt and mask is being scolded by his furious wife, who is counting a much smaller bag of money and glaring at him in disbelief.
